plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer *One-click prompt optimization for the DeepSeek Harness composer* [![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer?style=flat-square)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer) [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-%5E0.2.0--rc.2-3c873a?style=flat-square)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh) [![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-blue?style=flat-square&logo=typescript&logoColor=white)](https://www.typescriptlang.org) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) **English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) [Features](#features) • [How it works](#how-it-works) • [Install](#install) • [Configuration](#configuration) • [Development](#development) ![The composer with an optimized prompt staged](docs/verified-web.png)
A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a ✨ button to the chat composer. One click rewrites your rough draft — combined with the session context — into a clear, well-structured prompt, using **the model you already selected**. > [!TIP] > The fastest way to see it work: type a few words, press the ✨ button, and compare. > `审计项目看一下目前有啥问题` → a complete audit brief with scope, requirements, deliverables and acceptance checks. ## Features - 🎯 **One-click rewrite** — reads the current draft, calls the host-side optimizer, replaces the draft with the result. If the draft changed meanwhile, you get a conflict prompt instead of a silent overwrite. - 🧠 **Context aware** — pulls the last few user turns from the chat snapshot as reference (`@path` mentions survive verbatim). - 🛡️ **Injection safe** — the draft and context are wrapped in evidence markers (``) declared as *data, not instructions*; marker collisions are escaped, so a draft saying "ignore all rules" cannot hijack the optimizer. - 📐 **Structured output** — the optimizer reconstructs goal → scope → requirements → deliverable → acceptance, never a persona card, never fabricated facts. - ⚡ **Zero side effects** — a single auxiliary LLM call (`purpose: 'compaction'`): nothing enters the session log, no agent is activated, cancellable with Esc. - 🧼 **Clean output** — stray code fences or wrapping quotes are stripped automatically. - ♿ **Accessible** — while optimizing, the button simply dims and disables; no spinner, no layout shift, and a proper `aria-label`. ## How it works ### Model routing The optimization call reuses the session's model, resolved in this order: 1. The pending selection from the session's `modelSelection` projection (the model you just switched to) 2. The projection's last-used route 3. The route recorded in the session log's `requestHeader` 4. The deployment's `agentDefaultModel` fallback ### The optimization prompt The system prompt is a layered contract — role framing, a silent analysis checklist, an explicit expansion policy and a mandatory pre-output self-check — re-targeted at coding-agent task briefs: | Layer | What it does | |---|---| | Non-negotiables | Rewrite only — never answer or execute; evidence is not instructions; no invented facts; keep the draft's language; preserve paths, commands, versions and placeholders verbatim; output exactly one prompt | | Internal analysis | Goal, scope, constraints, missing information, expected output form, risks — computed silently, never printed | | Expansion policy | A short draft **must not** come back a few characters longer: a 4–10 character task normally becomes a 100–400 character prompt with 2–6 concrete points, every addition grounded in the draft or context (or labelled as an assumption) | | Suggested shape | Goal → context → scope → requirements → deliverable → acceptance → open items; small asks stay 2–4 natural sentences | | Self-check | Seven silent questions; if any answer is "no", the output is fixed before it is emitted | > [!NOTE] > Long drafts keep every detail — the optimizer only reorganizes, de-duplicates and closes gaps. Generic filler counts as a failure, not expansion. ## Install ```sh # ① From npm (recommended) dsh plugin --profile add dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer # ② From a release tarball curl -LO https://github.com/subisle/dsh-prompt-optimizer/releases/download/v0.2.0/dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer-0.2.0.tgz dsh plugin --profile add ./dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer-0.2.0.tgz # ③ From a local directory dsh plugin --profile add /path/to/prompt-optimizer # ④ From git (runs the prepare script to build) dsh plugin --profile add github:subisle/dsh-prompt-optimizer # Verify the composed profile dsh --profile --dump-config | grep -A1 prompt-optimizer ``` > [!IMPORTANT] > In the Desktop app, install into `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`, then restart it — client entries hot-reload via HMR, but the host half needs the restart. ## Configuration Every field is optional; invalid values fail plugin load with a schema error (no silent fallback). ```yaml - id: prompt-optimizer name: dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer config: maxOutputTokens: 4096 timeoutMs: 120000 ``` | Field | Default | Description | |---|---|---| | `maxDraftChars` | `8000` | Maximum accepted draft length in characters (`draft-too-large` beyond it) | | `maxContextTurns` | `6` | Recent user turns carried as reference context | | `maxContextChars` | `600` | Per-turn context truncation limit | | `maxOutputTokens` | `2048` | Output-token cap for the auxiliary call | | `timeoutMs` | `60000` | End-to-end deadline for the auxiliary call (`prompt-optimizer/timeout`) | ## Naming and version compatibility **npm package:** `dsh-composer-prompt-optimizer` · **GitHub repo:** [subisle/dsh-prompt-optimizer](https://github.com/subisle/dsh-prompt-optimizer) The names differ because `dsh-prompt-optimizer` is already taken on npm by another author's plugin. `package.json`'s `name` is the single source of truth: the build script derives the plugin row, the browser closure-factory id and both Typert manifests from it — change it once and run `npm run build`. All `dsh` dependencies are peers (no runtime `dependencies`); DSH validates them at compose time with `semver.satisfies(runtime, range, { includePrerelease: true })`. This package declares `^0.2.0-rc.2` — bundles outside the range are skipped by the profile, so bump the peer range when DSH moves to 0.3.x. ## Development ```sh npm install # also triggers prepare → automatic build npm run build # lib/index.js, lib/client.js, lib/typert.*, lib/types/ npm test # pre-release self-checks (81 checks) npm pack # distributable tarball ``` The browser bundle uses DSH's closure-factory format (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({id, factory})`) with everything inlined except the declared module table (react, cordis, ui-primitives…); CSS Modules compile into a plugin-owned style injector. ### Repository layout ``` prompt-optimizer/ ├── package.json # dsh.bundle(patch) + dsh.client(web) + peer contract ├── cordis.patch.yml # compose-layer: inserts the plugin row ├── build.mjs # self-contained build: tsc types + esbuild bundles + Typert artifacts ├── test/check.mjs # pre-release self-checks └── src/ ├── index.ts # host entry: mounts the Remote controller (exports Config) ├── host-controller.ts # promptOptimizer.optimize + routing + output normalization ├── types.ts # wire types + RemoteErrorDetailsMap extension └── client/ ├── index.ts # browser entry: $mount Remote + slot registration ├── PromptOptimizer.tsx # toolbar component ├── context.ts # conversation context extraction └── locales.ts # zh/en dictionaries ``` ### Self-check coverage (`npm test`) 1. **Manifest contract** — name/version/`type`/`dsh.bundle.patch`/`dsh.client.platform`, every `exports` subpath, `files` coverage, no runtime dependencies 2. **Compose layer** — exactly one `insert` row in `cordis.p

plugins.description: DeepSeek 峰谷价感知的任务执行器：平价时段跑 flash 任务批，峰价前挂定时任务推迟到下一个平价时段执行。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-peak-runner

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-peak-runner?color=4176E6)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-peak-runner)
[![ci](https://github.com/439436269-ctrl/dsh-peak-runner/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/439436269-ctrl/dsh-peak-runner/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

DeepSeek **峰谷价感知**的任务执行器：平价时段直接跑 `deepseek-flash` 的任务批；峰价快到时把任务攒进队列、挂一条定时器，到下一个平价时段自动执行完。

## 它解决什么问题

DeepSeek 官方按 UTC 时段两档计价：**01:00–04:00、06:00–10:00 为峰时价（约两倍），其余时段平价**；周末与法定假日全天平价。你把一批摘要/翻译/改写任务丢给它，它只在便宜的时候花钱。

与 [dsh-cost-meter](https://github.com/Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter) 用同一套时段口径，两边对「现在是平价还是峰价」的判断一致。

## 装（正式安装）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-peak-runner
```

然后重启 DSH。它插一行进组合，注册三个工具 + 一段系统提示：

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `peak_run({ prompts })` | 一批 prompt 交给 `deepseek-flash` 执行。平价时段立即跑；峰价时段（或距峰价不足 `leadMinutes` 分钟时）排队，等下一个平价时段自动执行 |
| `peak_schedule()` | 查看当前档位、下一个切换点、队列状态与定时器排定情况 |
| `peak_cancel({ id? })` | 取消队列中的待执行任务（不传 id 则取消全部） |

## 配置（profile 补丁层覆盖）

```yaml
- id: dsh-peak-runner
  config:
    enabled: true
    provider: deepseek-account
    model: deepseek-flash
    # 峰段窗口（UTC 小时，半开区间 [start, end)）；默认对齐 DeepSeek 官方口径
    peakWindows:
      - { start: 1, end: 4 }
      - { start: 6, end: 10 }
    # 峰价开始前多少分钟停止执行新任务、开始排队
    leadMinutes: 10
    # 推理档：off 是延迟/成本正确的档位（low 仍可能烧掉 2000+ 思考 token）
    reasoningEffort: "off"
    maxTokens: 2048
    timeoutMs: 45000
```

## 用法

在对话里直接说：

> 帮我把这 5 段文字各写一句摘要：……（然后调 `peak_run`）

或者问：

> 现在是什么档位？队列里还有什么？

## 开发（不装进 profile）

```sh
cd dsh-peak-runner && pnpm install     # 只需 @deepseek-ai/schemastery

DSH='/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh'
$DSH --profile <name> --patch "$PWD/dev.patch.yml" --dump-config | grep peak-runner
$DSH --profile <name> --patch "$PWD/dev.patch.yml" web
```

## 目录

```
lib/index.js         接线（name/inject/Config/apply）
lib/config.js        Config schema + DEFAULTS + resolveConfig
lib/tariff.js        时段计算（窗口表 → 当前档位/下一切换点）
lib/runner.js        模型调用（ctx.llm.stream + reasoning off）
lib/queue.js         任务队列（storage domain 持久化）
lib/scheduler.js     定时触发（自持 timer，不依赖可选的 ctx.schedule）
lib/tools.js         工具注册表
lib/prompt.js        系统提示文案
```

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH plugin conflict governance: diagnose silent plugin conflicts in DeepSeek Harness and get the exact patch that fixes each one. DSH 插件冲突诊断与修复建议。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-conflict-doctor

**插件冲突治理：把「装上了但没生效」变成一条可执行的结论。**

DSH 有大量手段告诉你插件*装上了*；没有任何手段告诉你插件*没在工作*。三类真实故障全部是静默的：

| 现象                         | 实际发生的事                                                               | 现有工具为什么看不见           |
| ---------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| 装完插件，功能不出现         | fiber 停在 `PENDING`，等一个没人提供的服务，不报错、不打日志               | 没有报错就没有信号             |
| 装第二个插件后整个功能没了   | tool id 重复 → 后注册者抛错 → **整行**加载失败，错误信息不指出另一个 owner | 错误只说「already registered」 |
| 「我明明关了它，怎么还生效」 | 后一层 patch 把前一层的 `disabled`/`config` 盖掉了                         | 层语义是整段替换、最后一层胜出 |

本插件把运行期图谱与磁盘上的 patch 层对齐，给出**谁和谁撞了 + 改哪一行**。

## 它检测什么

**运行期（live）**

| code                           | 严重度   | 含义                                                                              |
| ------------------------------ | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `live/tool-id-conflict`        | critical | 两个插件注册同一个 tool id；从失败 fiber 的错误里认出冲突名，并确认它已在注册表中 |
| `live/failed-fiber`            | critical | 任何启动失败的 fiber，带原始错误首行                                              |
| `live/pending-missing-service` | critical | fiber 停在 PENDING 且 `inject` 的服务无人提供——静默失败的根源                     |
| `live/duplicate-entry-id`      | critical | 两个模块占用同一个 Loader entry id（整树启动失败）                                |
| `live/unprovided-inject`       | warning  | 声明依赖的服务在整个进程里都不存在（下次重载就会挂）                              |

**磁盘组合（profile）**

| code                                | 严重度          | 含义                                                                                                                                                           |
| ----------------------------------- | --------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `profile/duplicate-row-in-layer`    | critical        | 同一 patch 层里 row id 重复                                                                                                                                    |
| `profile/module-under-multiple-ids` | critical / info | 同一模块挂两次。**config 不同 → info**（`dsh-tool-subagent` 用 `toolName: subagent` / `subagent_fork` 刻意挂两次）；config 相同或为空 → critical（真的挂重了） |
| `profile/disable-then-reinsert`     | critical        | 某层停用、后面的层又插进来                                                                                                                                     |
| `profile/missing-patch-file`        | critical        | bundle 声明的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 在磁盘上不存在                                                                                                                |
| `profile/tool-id-collision`         | critical        | 两个包在编译产物里声明了同一个 tool id。**这是静态版本比对永远覆盖不到的能力级冲突**                                                                           |
| `profile/peer-range-unsatisfied`    | warning / info  | 按包分组。已装版本**低于**声明最小值 → warning（宿主比插件旧，真会坏）；只是声明更旧 → info。**仅在版本权威性已确认时运行**（见下）                            |
| `profile/host-import-unsatisfied`   | warning         | 插件从宿主包里 import 了一个**当前宿主并不导出**的符号。这是「peer 版本字符串匹配 ≠ API 存在」的具体形态。**仅在版本权威性已确认时运行**                       |
| `profile/service-collision`         | warning         | 两个包注册同名服务。**按 realm 过滤**：浏览器侧包（`dsh.client`）不与宿主共享服务表，不参与比对                                                                |
| `profile/row-config-replaced`       | info            | 多层依次替换同一 row 的 config（DSH 的层语义，符合预期时无需处理，所以只作提示）                                                                               |
| `profile/dangling-override`         | warning         | patch 里的 `- id: X` 不对应任何已插入的 row（空操作，不报错）                                                                                                  |
| `profile/node-engine-unsatisfied`   | warning         | `engines.node` 不满足当前 Node。**仅在版本权威性已确认时运行**                                                                                                 |
| `profile/bundle-unresolved`         | info            | `dsh.profile.bundles` 里的名字在 node_modules 里解析不到                                                                                                       |

运行期还有两条需要跨两半才能看出的：

| code                           | 严重度   | 含义                                                                                         |
| ------------------------------ | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `live/pending-self-dependent`  | critical | fiber 等的服务正是**它自己**要提供的——自锁，永远不会激活。修复不是「装 provider」            |
| `live/outbound-tool-collision` | warning  | 两个**已加载**的插件都声明了同一 tool id，而该 id 还没进注册表：冲突是确定的，只是被时序掩盖 |

### 版本权威性：一次真实的误报与修正

这是本工具最重要的一条设计约束，来自一次被实测证伪的错误。

打包的桌面应用从**自己的 archive** 提供 profile bundle（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-base@0.2.0-rc.2`），而 `profiles/node_modules` 里可能是另一代（`0.1.0-rc.6`）。早期版本直接拿磁盘副本当基准，于是产出了 7 条**并不存在**的冲突：声称社区插件 import 了宿主没有的符号、peer 范围不满足。实测把那些符号在运行宿主的 archive 里数出来——`IconBranchOutlineRegular` 7 处、`resolveImageAttachmentAccess` 13 处，**全都在**。

所以现在：插件启动时先向 `pluginManager` 问运行中的真实版本，再决定要不要做版本敏感的判断。

- 两边一致 → `authoritative`，正常比对；
- 不一致 → `stale-disk`，**跳过** peer / import / engines 三类检查，并在报告里说明原因；
- 读不到运行版本 → `unknown`，同样跳过。

宁可不报，也不拿错误的基准报。结构类检查（重复 row、双挂载、层覆盖、配置被替换）不依赖版本，任何时候都照常运行。

每条 finding 都带 `refs`（涉及对象）、`evidence`（证据，不是猜测）、`impact`（会怎么坏）和至少一条 `fix`；能用 patch 修的直接给出可粘贴的 YAML。

## 安装

从插件市场（Settings → Plugin Market）搜索安装，或直接：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-conflict-doctor
```

然后把包名加进该 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`：

```json
{
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-conflict-doctor"] } }
}
```

或者不安装，直接用 overlay 验证组合层：

```bash
dsh --profile web --patch <path-to>/conflict-doctor/cordis.patch.yml --dump-config
```

> **关于名字。** npm 上的 `dsh-plugin-doctor` 是另一个作者的工具，做的是「兼容性 / 安全性 / 隔离安装 / 回滚」。本插件做的是**冲突诊断与修复**——谁和谁撞了、为什么静默失效、改哪一行。定位不同但名字几乎相同，会在市场上造成安装歧义，因此本包定名为 `dsh-conflict-doctor`。

## 使用

模型侧工具：

```
conflict_doctor { scope: "all" | "live" | "profile", profilePath?: string, format?: "markdown" | "json" }
```

用户侧命令：

```
/conflict-doctor
```

- `scope: "live"` — 只看运行中的进程（Loader 树、fiber 状态、服务、tool 注册表）
- `scope: "profile"` — 只读磁盘（bundle 清单 → 每层 patch → row ledger）
- `scope: "all"`（默认）— 两者都有

## 设计取向

1. **默认只读。** 不注册服务、不改配置、不碰注册表，只读 + 报告。一个「治理」插件自己成为故障源是荒谬的。
   但修复引擎提供了三条**不破坏这条线**的出路：`--dry-run` 在内存里试修、`--fix-out` 把修复写成
   profile 旁的惰性文件（DSH 不加载，挑错也不影响运行）、`--apply` **尚未实现**。详见
   [`docs/apply.md`](docs/apply.md)。
2. **只有一个硬依赖 `tools`。** `loader`/`commands`/`systemPrompt`/`pluginManager` 全部在用时 `ctx.get`——一个诊断插件如果自己停在 PENDING 就是个笑话。注册全部包在 `ctx.effect()` 里，卸载时干净撤销。
3. **宁缺毋滥。** 每条检测器都在真实 profile 上跑过并调过阈值。真实数据把第一版的 23 条噪音收敛到可执行的少数几条；宁可不报，也不拿错误基准报。
4. **纯函数内核。** 采集（`live.ts` / `static.ts` / `source.ts` / `hostface.ts`）→ 检测（`detect.ts`）→ 渲染（`render.ts`）都是纯函数，可以用 fixture 单测，不需要启动 harness。140 项检查覆盖每个检测器的正例+反例、asar 字节布局、导出面提取、四态版本判定、表达式白名单、键级 config diff、inject 环、真实 profile 扫描、以及 Cordis 集成。

## 主动播报

有 critical 冲突时，插件会把它写进**系统提示**（`systemPrompt.context`，order 50），而不是等你来问。没有冲突时贡献空字符串——健康的组合为此付出 0 token。内容只报结论与第一条修复，并明确要求模型在用户提出相关问题前**不要**擅自改配置。

## 能力边界（老实说）

- **tool id 归属无法 100% 归因。** dsh 的 tool 注册表不记录注册者，公开 API 也拿不到调用方 fiber。所以运行期只报告「冲突名 + 失败行」，跨插件的冲突归属由静态扫描（`defineTool({ name: '...' })` 字面量）补上。动态拼出的 tool 名不在静态视野内。
- **静默覆盖只能报症状。** `profile/row-config-replaced` 里无法判断被丢掉的那层 config 是否必需——因为语义上就是整段替换。
- **版本敏感的检查有真实基准。** 打包桌面版从自己的 archive 提供 bundle（`dsh-base@0.2.0-rc.2`），而 `profiles/node_modules` 里可能是另一代（`0.1.0-rc.6`）。现在直接从**运行宿主的 archive** 读取版本与导出面，判定为 `archive-authoritative` 后照常比对；只有既无 archive 又无运行版本时才弃权，并在报告里写明原因。详见 [`docs/version-authority.md`](docs/version-authority.md)。
- **名称类静态提取只认字面量。** `super(ctx, 'name')`、`provide('name')`、`defineTool({ name: '...' })` 能认；拼接出来的名字不能。所以报告措辞是「声明于编译产物」而不是「运行期已注册」。
- **`engines` / peer 是证据不是因果。** 范围不满足不等于一定坏，但它是「插件调了宿主里不存在的 API」的第一嫌疑人。
- **`!!js` 不求值。** 审计按原样记录 profile 提供的表达式——求值等于在审计里执行用户代码。因此 `disabled: !!js ...` 这类条件停用无法判定真假，相关行按「未停用」处理。
- **fiber 错误文本**读的是运行时记录的错误对象（`fiber._error`，非公

plugins.description: DSH A2UI Studio — let agents manage machines and apps, remember context, and create persistent A2UI-inspired interfaces.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH A2UI Studio

**Your agent manages. A2UI Studio remembers.**

A DeepSeek Harness plugin for delegating machine and application management to your agent. Describe the target and the job; the agent can register the machine, investigate its applications, save what matters, and build an interface you can use again.

[中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Download v0.3.2](https://github.com/zhaochengggg/dsh-a2ui-studio/releases/tag/v0.3.2) · [Setup](docs/setup.md) · [End-to-end walkthrough](docs/story.md)

## 1. Tell the agent what to manage

> “Register this machine as Queue server. Find the queue application and remember where it lives.”

The agent checks existing records and uses `machine_manage` to create or update the machine archive. Supply connection details through your approved access setup when needed; manual registration is an optional fallback, not a prerequisite.

![Agent registration result and the saved machine archive](docs/media/agent-register.gif)

*8 seconds · Review the completed agent registration and open its saved record.*

## 2. Turn application knowledge into a working panel

> “Show running, waiting, completed and failed jobs, with concurrency. Start read-only.”

The agent reads the application, records its location and purpose, and proposes a tailored card. You review the execution definitions before publication; the plugin keeps the notes, card versions and operation receipts.

![Saved application knowledge and the published card](docs/media/agent-card.gif)

*8 seconds · Inspect the saved application notes and refresh the published panel.*

## 3. Use it directly—or delegate the next job

Open the machine to use its saved panel. Click **@** when you want the agent to investigate or change something; it can retrieve the existing context instead of starting from scratch.

![Reference the machine in a conversation with @](docs/media/agent-mention.gif)

*7.5 seconds · Attach the machine to chat; no new request is submitted.*

*Three short recordings of real DSH, using fictional local demo data. Completed results are revisited, not presented as live generation. [Details and still images](docs/story.md).* The plugin keeps knowledge the agent explicitly saves; it does not automatically remember every conversation.

Another application: [dual-GPU monitoring and power controls](docs/gpu-walkthrough.md). The same workflow can leave you a very different interface.

## What is included

| Capability | What it gives you |
| --- | --- |
| Machine directory | Persistent records, multiple SSH paths, default connection, health checks, and @ references |
| Application cards | Model-authored layouts, data bindings, conditional controls, and numeric color scales |
| Persistent operations | Card revisions, publication review, execution permissions, and action receipts |
| Extensible UI | A component catalog plus custom card extensions when standard components are insufficient |
| Agent skills | Machine management, card authoring, and extension development guidance shipped with the plugin |

The UI follows an **A2UI-inspired** approach: the agent describes a structured interface and the host renders it. This is not a claim of full A2UI protocol compatibility. Custom extensions are a separate, code-bearing capability and should be reviewed accordingly.

## Install

Previously called DSH Control Studio. The install/package ID remains `dsh-control-studio` for compatibility; existing installations need no migration for this branding change.

**Prerelease. Linux and Windows desktop; DSH `0.2.1-alpha.1` / `0.2.1-rc.2`.** See [Windows setup and limits](docs/windows.md). Independent community project, not an official DeepSeek plugin.

Download and verify the prebuilt package:

```sh
curl -fL -o dsh-control-studio-0.3.2.tgz \
  https://github.com/zhaochengggg/dsh-a2ui-studio/releases/download/v0.3.2/dsh-control-studio-0.3.2.tgz
curl -fL -o SHA256SUMS \
  https://github.com/zhaochengggg/dsh-a2ui-studio/releases/download/v0.3.2/SHA256SUMS
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
```

After the checksum reports `OK`, install as the DSH user:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-control-studio-0.3.2.tgz --allow-build=esbuild
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

Restart DSH and refresh the browser. Replace `web` with your profile name if needed. This is **one package**; no legacy plugins are required. Use the release tarball, not a git install. `--allow-build=esbuild` approves the extension builder's dependency script; see [setup and permissions](docs/setup.md) before enabling execution.

## Start with a read-only card

Already using `dsh-machine-apps`? Follow the [rename migration guide](docs/migration.md) before installing. Do not enable both packages together.

Ask the agent to use `machine-management` to register the target and record its connection, then `app-cards-authoring` to inspect the application and propose a read-only panel. For a machine already in the directory, reference it with @. Add controls after confirming what each action executes.

Opening a card does not automatically apply its settings. Local execution is not authorized by default. This plugin does not change network exposure, proxies, authentication, or GPU services during installation.

## Go deeper

- [Setup, permissions, data locations, upgrades, and development](docs/setup.md)
- [GPU example: request, preview, and everyday use](docs/gpu-walkthrough.md)
- [Card authoring skill](apps/skills/app-cards-authoring/SKILL.md)
- [Custom extension skill](apps/skills/app-cards-extensions/SKILL.md)
- [Machine management skill](skills/machine-management/SKILL.md)

Have an application you want to manage? [Open an issue](https://github.com/zhaochengggg/dsh-a2ui-studio/issues) with your DSH version, intended panel, and redacted logs or screenshots. Do not include credentials or private machine addresses.

plugins.description: Per-request serving-intent hints for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): the X-Agent-Hint HTTP header on an independent chat-completions provider route. Install: dsh plugin add github:evan7ang/dsh-agent-hints
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-hints

Per-request serving-intent hints for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH): every main-line model request carries a structured **AgentHint on the `X-Agent-Hint` HTTP header** (UTF-8 JSON, base64url) — session identity, agent status, priority, and cache control — so a serving engine (your inference gateway) can observe and act on what the agent is doing, per the "agent signals, engine consumes" pattern.

The plugin registers an **independent provider route `deepseek-hint`** backed by its own chat-completions adapter. The official `deepseek-official` route stays mounted and remains the fallback; deployment switches via `agent-default-model.provider`. Zero harness source modification, zero harness runtime dependencies (cordis is touched as a structural duck type only).

English | [中文](README.zh.md) · Design notes: [docs/design.md](docs/design.md) ([中文](docs/design.zh.md))

## How it works

The harness `LlmAdapter` contract is thin (only `stream()` is required), and the official adapter constructs its HTTP headers inside its `request()` implementation with no extension point. This plugin therefore ships a self-contained adapter that implements the contract structurally and adds one header:

```http
POST {baseURL}/chat/completions
authorization: Bearer …
content-type: application/json
x-deepseek-harness-session-id: session-…          ← identity signal, aligned with the official adapter
x-agent-hint: eyJzZXNzaW9uIjp7InNlc3Npb25faWQi…   ← base64url of a UTF-8 JSON AgentHint
```

The request body stays in the provider's original chat-completions format and **never carries hint fields**. To an endpoint that does not understand the header, it is a harmless unknown header.

This differs from static header-injection approaches (e.g. wrapping `fetch` to set fixed headers like a `user-agent`): here the hint value is **derived per request** from the session's durable event log (call index, compaction epoch, last tool result time) and the session lineage — there is nothing static to configure.

### Header emission rules

- **Main-line requests only**: auxiliary calls (`compaction`, `session-title` purposes) and requests without a session identity carry no hint.
- `strict_priority` is **never sent** by an agent (trusted-control-plane field).
- `prediction` rides the same header when a source is configured (`predictionTrie` and/or `predictionStatic`); with no source configured the block is omitted and the wire shape is unchanged. Values come from an offline trie (longest tool-sequence-prefix match) with per-field static fallback.
- Session identity mirrors the official adapter: `x-deepseek-harness-session-id` (when a session id exists) and `x-deepseek-harness-compact: 1` (on compaction) are sent as-is.

### The `X-Agent-Hint` payload

```jsonc
{
  "session": {
    "session_id": "session-…",
    "agent_type": "agent",
    "call_index": 7,          // derived from the session's durable log (step/start count); restart-safe
    "epoch": 0                // derived from compaction/end count; restart-safe
    // "parent_session_id" / "derivation": {"relation": "spawn"|"fork", "join": "sync"|"async"} — lineage sessions only
  },
  "agent_status": { "state": "running", "state_since_ms": 1760000000000 },
  "priority": { "level": 3, "reason": "user_waiting" },          // configured; null omits
  "cache_control": [{ "type": "pin", "range": { "end": 1 } }],   // configured; null omits
  // "prediction": { "latency_ms": 8251, "remaining_calls": 2, "output_tokens": 640,
  //   "interval_ms": 251, "remaining_time_ms": 42000,
  //   "next_action": { "state": "tool", "tools": [{"name": "web_search", "expected_duration_s": 9}], "prob": 0.8 } }
  //   — only when predictionTrie/predictionStatic is configured; trie miss falls back per field
}
```

Out-of-band status events (`tool` → `running` → `finalize` per working session, incl. awaited tool names and call ids) are reported to the optional `statusSink` (local JSONL file); the `emit()` seam is where a gateway client takes over.

## Install

Built JS is committed to this repository (`lib/`), so installing from GitHub needs **no build-script permission**:

```sh
dsh plugin add github:evan7ang/dsh-agent-hints
```

Pin a commit for reproducibility: `dsh plugin add github:evan7ang/dsh-agent-hints#<sha>`. An npm package (`dsh plugin add dsh-agent-hints`) is planned but not yet published.

## Configure and deploy

The plugin is inert until you point it at an upstream. Override the `agent-hints` row in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (later layers replace the row's entire `config` value, so restate every key you need):

```yaml
- id: agent-hints
  config:
    baseURL: https://your-gateway.example.com
    apiKeyEnv: MY_GATEWAY_KEY
```

Then switch the model route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: deepseek-hint
  model: deepseek-flash
```

The API key resolves per request: credentials service first (`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` / Models page), then the environment variable named by `apiKeyEnv` — the same order as the official adapter.

### Configuration reference

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `baseURL` | string | inherits `$DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL` → `https://api.deepseek.com` | Upstream base; every chat request posts to `${baseURL}/chat/completions` |
| `apiKeyEnv` | string | inherits `$DEEPSEEK_API_KEY_ENV` → `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` | Environment-variable name resolved per request (credentials service first) |
| `agentType` | string | `agent` | Reported as `session.agent_type` |
| `priority` | `{level, reason}` or `null` | `{level: 3, reason: "user_waiting"}` | Soft priority; `null` omits the field |
| `cacheControl` | array or `null` | `[{type: "pin", range: {end: 1}}]` | Cache control entries; `null` omits |
| `thinking` | `"enabled"` / `"disabled"` | enabled | `disabled` limits every conversation request to `off` |
| `reasoningEffort` | `"off"/"low"/"high"/"max"` | `high` | Default reasoning effort when a request carries none |
| `models` | `{id, name, contextWindow, maxTokens}[]` | DeepSeek-V4 family catalog | Advisory model catalog for `resolveModel`; **provide real limits when pointing at your own gateway** (they feed compaction decisions) |
| `defaultContextWindow` | positive integer | `1000000` | Context window assumed for models absent from the catalog |
| `defaultMaxTokens` | positive integer | `256000` | Per-request output cap materialized when callers omit one |
| `statusSink` | string | unset (file sink off) | Local JSONL path for out-of-band status events |
| `statusEndpoint` | string | unset | Full status-event endpoint URL (Motor scheduler); overrides `statusAuto` |
| `statusAuto` | boolean | `false` | Derive the status endpoint from `baseURL`'s origin (`<origin>/agent-status`) |
| `predictionTrie` | string | unset (block off) | Offline prediction trie (built by `scripts/build-prediction-trie.mjs`); enables trie-sourced `prediction` values |
| `predictionStatic` | object | unset | Static per-field fallbacks (`latency_ms`/`remaining_calls`/`output_tokens`/`interval_ms`/`remaining_time_ms`); configuring this or `predictionTrie` turns the `prediction` block on |
| `predictionMinSamples` | positive integer | `5` | Minimum node sample count for a trie distribution to be trusted over the static value |
| `expectedResumeS` | positive number | unset | Expected seconds until resume, carried on `pause`/`suspend` status events (business callbacks provide the trigger) |
| `subagentToolNames` | string[] | `["subagent"]` | Tool names treated as subagent delegation for `derivation.join` and status naming |

Invalid config aborts composition at load time with a field path — request-time hint construction has no failure path.

## Known limits (v1)

- Chat-completions wire only; subset: text + tools + thinking + usage + abort. Image/file content is rejected explicitly (`UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT`), never silently degraded.
- The protocol subset must be kept in sync with the official adapter manually (the deployment target is your own gateway, so the subset is under control).
- `call_index`/`epoch`/`state_since_ms` ar

plugins.description: A 7x24 resident personal assistant for DeepSeek Harness: human-bound standing autonomy, self-wake across restarts, expiry-aware notices that stay silent unless they matter, and a read-only reach over every session, this machine and the person's work channels - it reads everything, drafts everything, and writes nothing.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-den

> A **7×24 resident personal assistant** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh).
> Not another chat window — an assistant that stays on, keeps its own memory, works while you are away, and stops to ask before it acts outside your trust boundary.

Status: **the core is implemented, tested, and active in a real profile.** This line deliberately carries no test count: a hard-coded one rotted repeatedly (307, 309, 316, 319, 320, 322, 323, 326, 327 — each time while the suite was in fact green), and the last rot happened one round after a "fix". So the line states what is stable and `npm test` prints what moves. The plugin is loaded inside a real DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 desktop profile — it is in that profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`, and the running host reports it as `fiberPhase: active` — registering 16 model-facing tools, the approval guard, the heartbeat, and an interactive status panel. Verified against the *running* system rather than only in tests: the heartbeat ticks on its 60-second cadence, and the panel is an **active occupant** of both `sidebar.panellist` (`id: dsh-den.status`, order 245) and the `main` panel (`key: dsh-den.status`) — read from the live browser page through the host's read-only Slot inspector, not from the plugin's own registration call.

**Those live sentences were re-established on 2026-10-14 against the instance reporting `startedAt: 2026-10-14T02:10:43.000Z`**, whose own freshness verdict is `known: true, stale: false` and which loaded this tree 1000 seconds after its last source edit. `npm run verify:live` exits 0 against it and **all seven live probes pass**: the heartbeat ticks on its 60-second cadence, the route answers, an agent **cannot** obtain standing autonomy from the live host, the approval gate is the only path to authority, the expiry rule works in the host's own directory, scenario isolation holds against the same store the host reads, and disk evidence shows the `den_*` tools really were invoked. The earlier instance, `08:43:05.676Z`, is why this paragraph exists: after the panel fix landed at `09:24:00` it was still serving the previous panel while six live probes went on printing passes — each one run on its own, and each one describing code that was no longer on disk. Two things now make that state impossible to report as a pass. The plugin reports `status.freshness`: the newest source edit beside it against its own start, computed per request rather than cached at boot, with "cannot tell" as its own answer instead of a healthy default. And every live probe script is chained behind `tools/require-fresh-host.mjs`, which refuses to run it when the instance is stale or cannot say.

**The panel change is verified by what the page asked for, not by pixels.** At `09:52:28` — 141 seconds after that boot — a `panel-autonomy-requested` event reached the route carrying a **real conversation id**, `session-95cc8a8d-…`. The previous panel had no conversation to pass (resolving the active session *was* the defect, and it passed `null`), and the host is confirmed to be running the new code, so only the dock can have sent it; the probe's own requests are identifiable by their literal session ids (`live-autonomy-probe`, `grant-bypass-probe`). Two independent facts — the host loaded this tree, and a request only the dock can make arrived — are firmer evidence than a screenshot, and a screenshot is still not claimed.

**The panel was taking most of the screen, and that was a design error rather than a layout one.** The dock above the message box rendered the entire self-check creation form — title, prompt, interval, submit — permanently. It was there for a reason: the dock is the one seat the shell hands a real conversation to, and `schedules/create` refuses without one, so the form had to live somewhere a conversation exists. But the *capability* needs a conversation; it does not need to be on screen. The dock is now one line of state — autonomy, its two controls, and a one-line `New` disclosure — and the empty state names the cheaper path: say «check CI every 30 minutes» in the conversation and the den adds it. That this is small is machine-checked rather than asserted: `tools/check-client-interaction.mjs` requires the dock to render **zero** inputs and no submit button until the disclosure is pressed (it rendered three inputs and a submit button before), then checks that the form still sends the same payload once opened. The logic is the one the reference assistants this project is measured against are built on — state at a glance, one thing at a time, and the human talks instead of filling in forms — stated as a reading rather than a quotation, because this plugin's own gate keeps `web_fetch` fail-closed in a profile with `approval: never`, so those pages were not readable from inside this session.

**The admitted wake happened — at the first heartbeat after the self-check came due.** On 2026-10-14 the panel minted a request, that token came back as a **human message**, and `den_set_autonomy` recorded `{ok: true, autonomy: true, boundToMessage: "b7b68b9f-…"}` for `session-95cc8a8d-…`. A self-check was then created with the 300-second floor; it came due at `02:34:26`, and the next tick — `02:34:43`, one cadence later — spent a turn and spoke: the ledger went `turns 0 → 1`, `spoken 0 → 1`, `notices 1`, and the trigger was consumed. The host recorded the event itself, `{"type":"wake-spoke","triggerId":"76e58cc0c47ef5…"}`, and `npm run drill:after` returned `RESULT: PASS` (exit 0) behind a guard that had just confirmed the instance loaded this tree. Three details make it more than one successful run. **The same call used to be auto-refused**: the gate audit still lists historical `den_set_autonomy → unknown-tool → ask` entries from the instance before the fix, and the successful call is absent from that list — it was classified as the den's own tool. That classification is the fix described in [`DESIGN.md`](DESIGN.md) §2.28–§2.30: the approval policy in this profile is not its own switch but a side effect of the permission preset (`danger-full-access` implies `approval: never`, where a gate `ask` means *never*, not *later*), so for a while every den tool that was not read-only was unreachable — memory, self-checks and authority alike. The answer was to classify den's own tools as its own, each with a stated bound, rather than to weaken the credential, shell and outbound rules above that table; those rules still refuse this session's own calls when they should. **The counters are read separately on purpose**: `turns` is charged after delivery and `spoken` only when the wake actually says something, so a wake that was admitted and judged not worth saying would have shown `turns 1, spoken 0` and failed the drill; both moved, so this was a wake that *spoke*. And **the grant is bound to a message**, not to a click: `boundToMessage` names the human message that carried the token. What is still only verified offline: a wake *after a restart*. Triggers, grants and the ledger all live on disk and survived the restart that moved this host to `02:10:43`; `test/cold-start.test.mjs` grants through the real token, stores a trigger, moves the clock past a restart and watches the wake fire — but the joined event (restart, then a wake) has not been observed live, and neither has its negative (a due trigger with no authority staying silent). Both need a human act, and `npm run drill:before` / `npm run drill:after` is how either would be measured. [`DESIGN.md`](DESIGN.md) §2.35 has the event chain and both gaps; §2.34 is the defect this drill found in itself the first time it ran for real.


**The wake spoke and nobody was told — the defect a reader of this panel found.** The page reported `Pending notices 1 / 1` and `Today's self-initiated turns 1` while the human had received nothing, and the strip above the message box still offered a **spent** token with the instruction to paste it. Both had the same shape of cause: a surface reporting state it had no way to update. `pendingNotices` knew only "deliverable" and "expired", so a notice that had been shown could not stop being pending — the count could nev

# zTerm

把 [zterm](https://github.com/guhanfei-ai/zterm) 的真实机器终端能力移植到 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）。DSH 负责 AI、对话与跨工具流程，zTerm 提供机器连接、终端、受限读工具、人类开启的读写操作和实际结果记录。安装包名为 `dsh-zterm`。

```text
DSH 对话中指定主机，结合 Grafana / OpenSearch 等证据
    → 取得资产与证据
    → zTerm 连接、读取、操作和核验机器
    → DSH 使用其它插件复核并归档结果
```

右侧工作台中，终端在左，主机／文件夹／JumpServer 资产列表在右。有 Better Sidebar 时使用独立 Tab，与脑图切换；没有时使用可调宽的独立大面板。

## 当前交付

- SSH 密码、私钥内容、宿主私钥文件；设置中保存命名凭证，多台主机按名称选用，私钥可直接选文件导入。
- 对话指定目标：先查远程主机，再查 JumpServer 授权；均无匹配时自动保存主机，使用选定的默认私钥凭证或宿主默认私钥文件。
- JumpServer 实例、按需节点树、分页资产、授权账号、fresh token 与 Koko SSH 网关。
- 可选 DSH 宿主本地 PTY；多终端、尺寸同步、手工输入、终端搜索、断开和重连。
- 终端默认 12px；设置中可调 8–32px，即时应用并保存在当前浏览器。
- 14 个 `zterm_*` 工具；默认读模式，人类在已绑定终端工具栏开启读写。
- 真正的退出码和完成边界；终端串行锁、取消、发送前授权复核、结果不明隔离、重复 callId 防重放。
- DSH 设置及凭据库、操作记录与导出、恢复上次目标列表。

本插件负责连接、操作与真实结果；外部系统的查询与归档由 DSH 的其它工具完成。

## 安装

基线为 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`、Node.js 22 以上。Better Sidebar 可选，已核对 Web `0.24.1` 的 Tab 契约。真实模型与真实测试机上的验收请自行完成；离线检查和界面夹具不能替代该验收。

可以把已生成的本地包安装到目标 profile，例如 Web profile：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "/path/to/dsh-zterm/out/dsh-zterm-0.1.10.tgz"
```

本地源码联调可使用：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "link:/path/to/dsh-zterm"
```

`cordis.patch.yml` 使用插件 ID `zterm` 和包名 `dsh-zterm`。通过现有 DSH 界面／方式加载或重载插件，然后刷新页面。以上示例仅操作 Web profile，桌面 profile 不受影响。

包管理器须允许本插件的 `postinstall` 和需要的原生依赖构建脚本。`scripts/prepare-native.mjs` 仅修复本依赖目录中 macOS `node-pty` 的 `spawn-helper` 执行位；不会改系统文件。SSH 不需要本地 PTY 原生模块；开启宿主本地终端才需要可用的 `node-pty`。如果安装策略跳过了本插件脚本，应在本插件目录中执行该脚本后再验收本地 PTY。

日常检查与构建不执行 Git 写操作，也不启动或重启服务。维护者的发布入口见下方「发布」。

## 开始使用

1. 在「设置 → zTerm」的【保存设置】下方管理凭证：填写名称、类型和内容，私钥可选择文件导入。添加主机时选择已保存凭证的名称；同一凭证可以供多台主机使用。也可设置默认 SSH 私钥凭证，让 AI 自动新增主机时直接选用。
2. 直接在对话中指定要访问的主机名或 IP。AI 使用 `zterm_connect` 自动查找、保存并连接；也可以点击「zTerm」，从右侧选择已保存的目标。
3. 点击目标建立连接；通过可信渠道核实首次 SSH 指纹。连接完成后点「绑定 AI」，或由 AI 调用 `zterm_bind`。
4. 让 AI 用目录、文件、系统、进程或端口读工具检查机器。默认读模式下通用命令被拒绝。
5. 需要修改时，人类在当前已绑定终端手工勾选「允许AI写操作」开启读写模式；未勾选时保持读模式。AI 可连续执行策略允许的命令，默认每次授权最多 100 条。
6. 通过读工具、监控或日志复核实际效果，再使用 `zterm_results` 把记录交给其它插件归档。

手工输入后，AI 暂停并切回读模式。结束 vim／less 等交互程序、确认回到空闲 Shell 后，再点「确认空闲 Shell」。切换可见标签不会切换 AI 绑定目标。

完整流程、设置和常见问题见 [中文使用指南](USERGUIDE.zh-CN.md)。

## 检查与构建

在项目目录中执行：

```sh
npm ci --cache ".cache/npm"
npm run verify
npm run check:package
node "scripts/check-host.mjs" "<DSH 安装目录>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh"
npm pack --ignore-scripts --pack-destination "out"
```

`verify` 包含 TypeScript、Vitest、宿主与客户端构建。测试只使用虚构数据、独立临时目录以及测试拥有的回环 HTTP／SSH／PTY，不连接真实机器。SDK 检查使用已安装包创建临时 Cordis 上下文，不启动真实 DSH。

## 发布

[deploy.sh](deploy.sh) 沿用 dsh-grafana 的维护者手动发布流程：

```sh
./deploy.sh release   # 输入版本号，验证后提交、打标签并推送
./deploy.sh build     # 安装开发依赖、准备原生依赖、验证和编译，打包到 dist/
./deploy.sh publish   # 校验当前版本安装包，发布到 npm 与 GitHub Release
./deploy.sh all       # 依次执行上述三步
```

发布链路默认限 main 分支，凭证和确认提示与来源项目一致。构建保留已有版本产物；分发只使用当前包名与版本对应的归档，并核对包内版本、宿主及客户端 bundle。脚本可从任意目录调用，不安装到 DSH profile，也不重启 Web 或桌面服务。

`release` 和 `all` 包含 Git 写操作，`publish` 会上传安装包，由维护者本人执行；AI 在本项目的 Git 写禁令仍然有效。

## 执行和数据边界

AI 执行要求空闲 POSIX Shell。每次调用使用独立子 Shell，`cd`／`export` 不改变后续调用的环境。结果不明的操作不会自动重试；核实远端后重建连接。

终端在 DSH 宿主执行，本地终端对应宿主而非浏览器电脑。授权只在内存中，刷新页面、换绑定目标、重连或插件重载均不恢复旧读写权限。

配置存放在 DSH 设置，秘密存放在 DSH 凭据库；插件的指纹、调用标识、目标列表和操作记录在 `$DSH_HOME/zterm/`，未设置时为 `~/.dsh/zterm/`。记录和终端导出有明确上限，不能作为外部归档成功的回执。不要把任意远端输出都视为已完全去除秘密的内容；人工终端本身会显示机器实际输出。

MIT，保留 [zterm 原始许可](LICENSE)；来源及依赖许可见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

plugins.description: Aqua glassmorphism theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH v0.2.x / desktop v0.22.3+) — original by WYH66666666, adapted for 0.2.x
plugins.readme_text:
># @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-aqua

**Aqua** 是一层高自由度的玻璃质感主题（glassmorphism），套在 DeepSeek Harness 网页端：顶栏、侧边栏、输入框、统计行、轨迹视图全部变成磨砂玻璃片，支持流体背景或图片/视频壁纸。关掉总开关即完全还原原生界面，不改 DSH 任何一行源码。

> **署名 / Credits**
> - 原作者：**WYH66666666** — https://github.com/WYH66666666/DSH-Transparent-UI-Plugin
> - 0.1.1-rc.2 适配：**du-u-uck** — https://github.com/du-u-uck/DSH-Transparent-UI-Plugin
> - v0.2.x 适配（本仓库）：**acdsh4869**

> **修改声明 / Modification Notice**
>
> 本仓库是原作品的**修改 / 适配版**，不是原创。
> - 原作者（Original author）：**WYH66666666**
> - 修改内容（Changes）：DeepSeek Harness **0.2.x** 兼容适配
> - 修改日期（Date of modification）：**2026-10**
> - 维护仓库（Maintained at）：`acdsh4869/dsh-aqua-theme`
> - 许可（License）：**AGPL-3.0**（沿用上游许可）

![](assets/1.png)

![](assets/2.png)

![](assets/3.png)

![](assets/4.png)

## 特性

- **双模式**：**云母效果**把布局改成悬浮玻璃卡片（模糊度、磨砂度可调）；**兼容模式**保持原版排版不变，只把材质换成通用玻璃，其他插件的界面也会自动玻璃化
- **背景自由**：流体板（色调/深浅可调）或自定义图片/视频壁纸（铺满页面、比例不变，可单独调模糊度/磨砂度）；浅色壁纸配浅色模式、深色壁纸配深色模式观感更佳
- **背景亮度**：自动跟随深浅模式——深色模式 0–50 压暗、浅色模式 50–100 提亮，50 原样
- **粒子鲸鱼 / 小鱼 / 网状交互 / 鼠标辉光 / 悬停下压**等环境与悬停装饰，均可单独开关
- **一键恢复默认**：设置里的「恢复默认效果」按钮可把全部调节项恢复出厂默认
- 一键开关：关闭即完全还原原生界面，无残留

## 安装（v0.2.x 适配版）

> ⚠️ **npm 一键安装（`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-client-ui-aqua`）拉到的是未适配 v0.2.x 的旧版**，请勿使用，直到本适配版发布到 npm。

### 方式一：PowerShell 一键安装（推荐）

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/acdsh4869/dsh-aqua-theme/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

脚本会：① 从本仓库下载最新 Release；② 把插件链接进 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-client-ui-aqua`；③ 在 `profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml` 登记 `ui-aqua`（幂等，重复运行安全）。完成后**刷新 Web 界面**即可。

指定版本或分支：`-Version 'v2.0.0-rc.1'` / `-Version 'main'`；DSH 不在默认位置时加 `-DshHome`。

### 方式二：本地文件夹安装

下载或 clone 本仓库到本地，然后：

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command ".\install.ps1 -Source '绝对路径\dsh-aqua-theme' -Profile web"
```

本地路径会建立 **junction 软链**（实时生效，之后在本文件夹里改代码/重建会直接反映到 DSH，无需重装）。

**macOS / Linux（手动三步）：**

```sh
git clone https://github.com/acdsh4869/dsh-aqua-theme.git
ln -s "$PWD/dsh-aqua-theme" "$DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-aqua"
```

再往 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 追加：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: ui-aqua
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-aqua'
```

> 💡 也可以把整个仓库文件夹丢给其他 Agent 帮忙安装，有问题让它自己修复。

## 使用

刷新 Web 界面，Aqua **默认开启**：

- **总开关**：设置 → 插件 → 点击 **Aqua / dsh-client-ui-aqua** bundle 卡片进入详情页 → 玻璃主题开关卡片。
- **全部调节**：设置 → 通用设置 → 外观 正下方（无独立标题）—— 模式（云母/兼容）、模糊度/磨砂度、流体颜色、背景亮度、背景（流体/壁纸）、壁纸设置、环境装饰（鲸鱼/小鱼/网状交互）与悬停效果开关，以及「恢复默认效果」一键按钮。总开关关闭时整块调节自动隐藏，界面完全恢复原生样式。

> 若刷新后未出现 Aqua 卡片，重启 dsh web 进程后再试。

## 适配 v0.2.x 说明（当前版本）

本分发版针对 **DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`（含桌面端 v0.22.3 及以上）** 完成适配，版本号 `2.0.0-rc.1`。主要变更：

1. **`ctx.settingsScope` 服务被移除**：插件主卡片迁移到 **`plugins.bundle.config`**（keyed，key = npm 包名）。
2. **`ctx.slots.inject(name, factory)` 回归**：注册恢复为 `ctx.effect(() => ctx.slots.inject(...))`。
3. **`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime` 消失**：`defineStore` 改用 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store`；`ctx.slots` 类型合并来自 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-renderer/client`。
4. **图标改名**：`IconCheckOutline16` → `IconCheckOutlineRegular`。
5. **依赖声明**：`dsh.client.inject` = locale / ui-theme / ui-slots；peerDependencies 只留 `@deepseek-ai/cordis ~4.0.4` + `react ^18.2.0`（不声明 `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer，宿主版本检查即通过）。
6. **构建管线**：新增 `scripts/wrap-client.mjs`——把 tsdown ESM 产物后处理为 DSH 要求的 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load(...)` 包裹格式，并直接从 `src/client/` 内联全局主题 CSS（rolldown 会摇掉纯副作用的 CSS 导入，导致早期构建主题整体缺失）。
7. **0.2.x 新布局容器透明化**：`centerCol`/`rightbarCol` 布局列与侧栏面板 frame 根节点的自绘不透明底色置为透明，流体背景可透至主区域。
8. **兼容模式修复**：0.2.x 里 `panel` 类片段命名整栏大容器，已从磨砂选择器中移除（避免半屏模糊）。
9. **新增「恢复默认效果」按钮**：一键恢复出厂默认（保留开关状态）。

细节与历史（含 0.1.1-rc.2 适配记录）见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

## 开发

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run bundle   # tsdown + tsc + wrap-client.mjs → 完整 lib/
```

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-liao-github

在 DSH 插件页面与设置页面中管理本机 GitHub CLI 授权。优先复用已安装的 `gh`；首次缺少工具时可一键准备。不会另存令牌，也不会把完整令牌传给界面。

## 0.3.0：首次使用引导

- 「准备工具 → 登录账号 → 开始使用」分步引导，已有账号保持直接进入概览。
- 缺少 `gh` 时一键下载 GitHub CLI 官方稳定版，按操作系统与架构选择安装包，校验官方 SHA-256 清单后解压并检查版本。
- 安装到当前用户的 `~/.local/bin/gh`（Windows 为 `gh.exe`）；不安装包管理器、不需要管理员权限，不修改 PATH，也不覆盖已有文件。
- 准备过程显示进度，可取消、重试；缺少系统解压工具或网络不可用时提供官方手动安装入口。
- 已手动安装后点击「我已安装，重新检测」即可识别，无需重启 DSH。
- 支持 macOS、Linux、Windows 的 x64 / ARM64 官方便携包；本机实际验证 macOS ARM64 下载至隔离目录的完整链路。
- 36 项测试覆盖安装、取消、重复请求、校验与首次使用界面。

## 0.2.1：热更新样式修复

- 修复旧实例卸载时移除样式、但授权页面仍显示而导致的裸排版。
- 插件详情与全局设置入口独立挂载时，都会在首帧恢复当前版本的作用域样式。
- 多个入口复用一份样式，不重复注入；原有登录、退出和授权操作保持不变。
- 新增样式保留与丢失恢复回归测试，21 项测试通过。

## 0.2.0：界面与交互

- 账号信息压缩为概览卡：本地字母头像、授权状态、凭据来源、Git 协议与可读权限标签。原始 scope 保留在提示中。
- 刷新与添加账号放在顶部；退出为较低视觉权重的账号操作，仍需明确确认。
- SSH 与仓库检查分别反馈状态、进度、结果和错误；快速连点不产生重复请求，重试清除过时结果。
- 远端撤销、SSH 密钥入口与 CLI 诊断折叠到高级选项，默认页面更紧凑。
- 登录显示两步引导；确认区获得键盘焦点，Esc 取消后返回触发按钮；减少动态效果的系统偏好得到尊重。

## 功能

- 查看 github.com 的账号、当前账号、授权验证结果、权限范围、凭据来源和 Git 协议。
- 使用 gh 的官方网页登录流程添加或重新授权账号；显示一次性代码、授权入口与等待状态，支持取消等待。
- 切换当前账号和退出指定本机账号，执行前确认影响范围。
- 单独检查 SSH 身份；只读检查指定仓库的 API 写入权限，说明分支保护与 SSH 仍可能影响 Git 推送。
- 打开 GitHub 应用授权与 SSH 密钥管理页面。彻底撤销 GitHub CLI 应用授权可能影响其他设备；最终操作由用户在官方页面确认。

## 使用

将插件加入 DSH profile，然后在插件页面准备工具并登录。宿主使用 Node 18 或更新版本，无额外运行时 npm 依赖。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:oliblue-evan/dsh-liao-github
```

打开「插件 → GitHub 授权」即可使用；「设置 → GitHub 授权」提供相同界面。

首次使用：缺少工具时点击「一键准备工具」，下载完成后直接点击「连接 GitHub 账号」。工具已安装会跳过准备步骤；有现有账号则直接显示概览。

登录：阅读权限说明后开始网页登录，输入一次性代码，在 GitHub 页面确认账号和权限。完成后自动显示账号。

手动安装：展开备用安装说明，按 [GitHub CLI 官方说明](https://cli.github.com/) 安装，再点击「我已安装，重新检测」。在插件运行时安装工具也无需重启。Windows 等环境若终端尚未包含用户工具目录，其他程序需通过完整路径调用 `gh`；插件能直接找到它。

本机退出仅移除 gh 登录配置与该账号的本机存储凭据。GitHub 远端令牌和 SSH 密钥需要在官方页面单独管理。环境变量 GH_TOKEN / GITHUB_TOKEN 优先控制授权时，本机账号变更功能禁用，需在原启动环境管理变量。

## 边界

- 第一版仅管理 github.com；Enterprise 主机不在此页面中列出。
- 登录授权由 gh 处理，通常请求 repo/read:org/gist。插件不接收密码、不设置额外 scopes、不上传或生成 SSH 密钥、不改写 Git 协议或 git credential helper。
- 凭据保管方式由 gh 决定；钥匙串不可用时可能退回 gh 配置文件，界面显示实际来源。
- 本机网页 API 限制来源；修改操作必须 POST JSON、携带页面取得的随机 nonce 并明确确认。只接受固定操作与严格校验的账号/仓库参数；不用 shell 拼接。
- 登录等待最多 15 分钟；取消或停用插件时终止子进程。查询有时间和输出大小限制。
- SSH 检查不接受新的主机密钥；需要手动配置并核对 GitHub 主机指纹。SSH 与当前 gh 账号可能不同。
- 仅登录等待或准备工具期间短时轮询；普通页面不定时查询。账号状态复用 5 秒缓存，手动刷新绕过缓存。
- 本机退出、切换对该电脑共用 gh 的其他工具同样生效；插件不是一份独立授权。

## 开发与测试

客户端采用 DSH 单文件 ModuleLoader 工厂，宿主仅使用 Node 内置模块。安装开发依赖后执行 `npm test`。测试覆盖本机接口守卫、脱敏、参数校验、账号操作、登录状态、取消/卸载、SSH 退出码和客户端确认流程；真实登录/退出不用于测试现有账号。

## 本机验证

36 项回归测试通过；在 DSH 已安装列表与插件页面验证了账号信息、网页登录和退出前确认界面。首次使用页面通过独立测试预览验证，不改动既有账号。仓库 API 权限和 SSH 连接已进行真实只读检查。登录完成、切换和退出使用模拟进程/账号测试，不改变用户的现有授权。

plugins.description: DSH plugin that lets the model drive the right-Sidebar browser: read pages, click, type, navigate, switch phone/tablet/desktop viewport sizes, and screenshot. Desktop only; never touches app.asar.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-browser

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Let the model actually **use** the DSH right-Sidebar browser: read a page's text,
click and type in it, navigate, size the viewport, and take screenshots — from
ordinary tool calls in the conversation.

It also adds a **phone / tablet / desktop / custom viewport switcher**, so you can
see how a site renders at another size without leaving the app.

```
browser_navigate { url: "https://example.com" }
browser_read     { mode: "elements" }     -> refs e1, e2, …
browser_act      { action: "type", ref: "e1", text: "hello" }
browser_act      { action: "click", ref: "e2" }
browser_screenshot {}                     -> see the layout
browser_viewport { preset: "phone" }      -> re-render at 390×844
```

> **Desktop only.** The tools drive an Electron `<webview>` guest. In Web
> profiles the Sidebar browser is a sandboxed cross-origin `<iframe>`, whose DOM
> cannot be read at all, so the tools answer with an explicit reason naming the
> Web profile instead of pretending to work. `browser_tabs` still lists those
> tabs — as `mounted: true` with `carrier: "iframe"` — so you can see that the
> tab exists and why it cannot be driven.

> **Third-party, non-invasive plugin.** It mounts from your DSH profile, never
> touches `app.asar`, and leaves the built-in browser exactly as shipped.

- [Install](#install) — one command, or the Plugins page
- [Tools](#tools) — what the model can call
- [Which size to use](#which-size-to-use) — pick desktop or phone, not the default
- [Viewport sizes](#viewport-sizes-phone--desktop--custom) — the UI side
- [Compatibility](#compatibility) — verified against DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`
- [Known limitations](#known-limitations) — read before filing an issue

## Tools

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `browser_tabs` | List this Session's browser tabs: id, title, url, loading state, **whether the load failed** (`failed`), whether the identity was inferred (`unverified`), whether each is mounted and drivable, which is `active`, and its `carrier` (`webview` on Desktop, `iframe` on Web). |
| `browser_read` | Read a tab: `mode: 'text'` (default) for visible text, `'elements'` for the interactive elements you can act on, `'html'` for page HTML. Check `failed` first — a failed load reads as empty. `truncated` means the element cap was reached — hidden elements are filtered out silently and never counted as truncation. |
| `browser_act` | `click`, `type`, `press`, `scroll`, `select`, `reload`, or `wait`. Target an element by the `ref` from a `'elements'` read, or by a CSS `selector`. `reload` takes `ignoreCache: true` to bypass the cache. `wait` with a `selector` becomes a real wait — see *Waiting for the page* below. |
| `browser_screenshot` | Capture the visible viewport as an image block the model can see. Pass a `preset` to size and capture in one call; the result reports the size it actually used and whether the page was confirmed to have reflowed (`confirmed`). A failed page is refused rather than captured. |
| `browser_navigate` | Open a URL in a new tab, or navigate an existing one. |
| `browser_viewport` | Read or change the tab's viewport size: `auto`, `phone` (390×844), `tablet` (834×1112), `desktop` (1280×800) or `custom`. The page reflows for real, so its own responsive breakpoints apply. Omit `tabId` to target the only mounted tab; the read always reports the tab it resolved. `custom` appears only for the `custom` preset. |
| `browser_close` | Close one tab of this Session, so tabs opened while investigating something can be cleaned up. Closure is confirmed before the call reports success. |
| `browser_eval` | Run JavaScript in the page — the only way to read layout geometry (`getBoundingClientRect`, `scrollHeight`, `getComputedStyle`). **Always listed; refuses until `enableEval: true`** (see configuration), so the capability is discoverable instead of unguessable. An expression returns its value; a statement body returns what it explicitly `return`s. |

A typical loop:

```
browser_navigate { url: "https://example.com" }
browser_read     { mode: "elements" }          -> refs e1, e2, …
browser_act      { action: "type", ref: "e1", text: "hello" }
browser_act      { action: "click", ref: "e2" }
browser_read     { mode: "text" }              -> confirm what changed
browser_screenshot { preset: "desktop" }       -> see the real desktop layout
browser_screenshot { preset: "phone" }         -> and the 390px-wide one
browser_close    { tabId: "tab4" }             -> tidy up when finished
```

`tabId` may be omitted whenever the Session has exactly one mounted browser tab.
With several, call `browser_tabs` first and name the one you mean.

### Reading a failed page

Three fields describe three different things, and none of them can be inferred
from the others:

| Field | Means |
|---|---|
| `mounted` | The tab is in the DOM and could be driven — **not** that it loaded. |
| `loading` | Electron says a navigation is in flight. A *failed* load is not loading. |
| `failed` | The tab is on Chrome's network-error page, so there is no site content. |

So `mounted: true, loading: false, failed: true` is a completely ordinary
combination: a tab that is open and finished failing. Before `failed` existed, a
page that never loaded looked identical to a healthy one, and the only way to
tell was to read it and notice the text was empty.

`unverified: true` is the other half: the page could not be asked anything (its
renderer is wedged, or the document is unreachable), so `url` and `title` are the
last navigation's, not the current document's. Treat them as a hint, not a fact.

Both matter for screenshots, which is where the confusion cost the most: a
capture is **refused** when either is set. A failed load paints Chrome's error
page, and a wedged renderer paints a blank surface — either way the image is not
the site, and returning it as a successful capture is how a page that never
loaded gets mistaken for a page that "did not render". Note that `failed` cannot
even be evaluated when the page is unscriptable, so `unverified` is doing real
work rather than restating it.

So `unverified` is deliberately *not* just a warning label: it is the condition
that makes a capture unverifiable. Inside a capture the identity probe is given
more patience than elsewhere (up to 4 s) precisely so a genuinely heavy page —
the several-iframes case a 15 s budget exists for — is not refused merely for
being briefly busy.

Note that this is about *transport* failures only. An HTTP error the site itself
rendered — a 404 page — is a real document and stays fully readable and
screenshotable.

## Waiting for the page

`browser_act { action: "wait" }` has two forms, and the difference matters on any
page a framework renders.

**A fixed sleep** — `{ action: "wait", timeoutMs: 2500 }` — sleeps and returns.
Rarely what you want, for a reason worth stating: the plugin's own notion of "the
page has loaded" is Electron's **navigation** state, which a single-page app
clears as soon as its HTML and scripts arrive, long before React (or anything
else) has mounted and painted. So the page reports itself loaded while the screen
is still empty, and a sleep is a guess that is too short on a slow machine and
wasted on a fast one. A report measured exactly that: a 2500 ms guess in a loop
that ran ten times.

**A named condition** waits for something observable instead:

```
browser_act { action: "wait", selector: ".todo-list", state: "visible" }
```

- `state: "visible"` (the default) — the element is **drawn**. This is what "the
  app has rendered" usually means.
- `state: "attached"` — the element merely **exists**. Weaker, and worth knowing
  about: an element can exist while `display: none`. A report counted hidden rows
  as present and concluded a layout had no overflow, so the two are kept distinct.
- `state: "hidden"` — satisfied by **absent as well as invisible**, so it works for
  waiting out a spinner that gets removed rather than hidden.

Omit `timeoutMs` and the wait uses the rest of the call's own budget (still
bounded, never longer than the call).

The condition is polled **inside the page**, so one tool call watches for

# dsh-plugin-web-socks-proxy

DeepSeek Harness 插件：让 `web_fetch` 在访问境外网站时自动走本机代理（默认 `socks5h://127.0.0.1:7890`，即 Clash 默认混合端口），其余站点保持直连。

**v1.1.0 起，代理在「设置 → 通用设置 → 网络代理」里随时可改**，无需动配置文件：

- **范围**：按域名自动分流（默认）/ 全部走代理 / 直连（停用）；
- **协议**：`SOCKS5（远程解析域名）`（`socks5h://`，推荐）/ `SOCKS5（本地解析域名）`（`socks5://`）/ `HTTP CONNECT`（`http://`）；
- **地址与端口**：改完按回车或移出输入框即保存，立即生效（写入 profile 补丁层的 volatile 覆盖，热重载）。

`bypassDomains`（localhost、127.0.0.1、.cn、本机服务端点等）在任何模式下都保持直连。

## 工作方式

- 注册一个 id 为 `web-socks-router` 的 `WebFetchProvider` 到 `ctx.web`，并把 `web` 服务的 `fetchProvider` 指向它。
- 每一跳 URL 独立决策路由：
  - `mode: auto`（默认）：仅 `proxyDomains` 列表中的域名走代理（`bypassDomains` 优先级更高）；
  - `mode: always`：除 `bypassDomains` 外全部走代理；
  - `mode: never`：全部直连（插件仍在位，方便快速关闭）。
  - 以上三项即设置界面「网络代理」行的三个选项；`proxy` 与 `mode` 是 volatile 配置字段，界面写入后由 config-editor 持久化进 profile 补丁。
- 域名规则：裸域名 `google.com` 匹配自身及全部子域；`*.example.com` 只匹配子域。
- `socks5h://` 由代理端解析域名（推荐）；`socks5://` 本地解析后再连代理（会做公网地址校验）。
- 代理连接失败时报错 `WEB_PROXY_UNAVAILABLE`（提示检查本地代理客户端），不会静默直连泄露流量。
- 直连路径复刻了官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http` 的安全姿态：仅 HTTP(S)、拒绝 URL 内嵌凭据、解析结果全部校验为公网地址并锁定连接、仅跟随同源重定向、字节/字符上限、按 Content-Type/charset 解码。

## 附带能力

- 注册一段系统提示（`web-socks-proxy`，可用 `promptSection: false` 关闭），让 Agent 知道：
  `web_fetch` 会自动走代理；shell 命令需要代理时先设 `ALL_PROXY`（PowerShell：`$env:ALL_PROXY = 'socks5://127.0.0.1:7890'`；bash：`export ALL_PROXY=socks5://127.0.0.1:7890`），curl 也可以 `-x socks5h://127.0.0.1:7890`。

## 安装

桌面端「设置 → 插件」或插件管理器安装本目录（本地 file 包），安装后自动作为 bundle 加入 desktop profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`。配置位于 bundle 自带的 `cordis.patch.yml`（插入行 id 为 `web-socks-proxy`），可在配置编辑器中直接修改。

## 卸载/回退

在插件管理器中停用或移除本 bundle 即可：随 bundle 注入的 `web` 行覆盖一并消失，基础层的 `fetchProvider: http` 自动恢复，行为回到原始直连。

## 故障诊断

超时/连接错误信息带有 `stage` 字段，指示停滞的阶段，例如：

- `tcp connect direct …` / `SOCKS proxy 127.0.0.1:7890 socks-greeting`：代理客户端未监听或不可达，确认 Clash 等本地代理在运行；
- `await-connect-reply …`：CONNECT 请求已发出但代理未回复（通常是代理端上游节点/规则问题）；
- `tls handshake …`：隧道已建立但 TLS 失败（一般是代理上游被干扰）；
- `http exchange …`：TLS 正常，等待 HTTP 响应。

超时错误同时附带 `trace`（SOCKS 帧读取的事件序列），可用于进一步定位。握手阶段停滞的错误里 `…ms since connect` 表示从 TCP 连上到超时的耗时。

## 开发

- 修改 `lib/index.js` 后，若 profile 补丁层将本目录加入了 hmr 的 `root` 监视列表（`- id: hmr / config: root: [<本目录>]`），改动会自动热重载；否则需重启 DeepSeek Harness 才会重新导入模块（启用/停用开关不会重新导入已缓存的 ESM 模块）。
- 仓库内另有两个独立诊断脚本（与插件无关，仅辅助排障）：`../socks-diag.mjs`（裸 SOCKS5+TLS 协议探测）与 `../provider-diag.mjs`（在宿主外直接运行 provider 代码）。

plugins.description: DSH 防呆插件：safe_kill 工具（自动排除自身与祖先进程链）+ bash 命令预检 + 可扩展规则库。Zero-dependency safety guard for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-whale-guard 🛡️

鲸鱼娘**防呆插件**：把「一天犯四次的低级错误」变成工具层面的硬拦截。

> 起因：2026-10-09 一天里，鲸鱼娘因为同一个坑反复翻车 —— `pkill -f "FurMark_GUI"` 把自己的命令行也匹配上了，于是**杀掉自己**。主人提议：「不如写个插件专门拦这些智障操作。」

## 它做三件事

| # | 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ① | **`safe_kill` 工具** | 按模式杀进程，**自动排除自身 + 全部祖先进程链**。以后杀进程不用再手写 `pkill`。 |
| ② | **bash 命令预检** | 调 bash 工具前扫描命令文本：命中危险模式就**拒绝执行**并给出安全替代写法；命中风险模式就放行但插一条醒目告警。 |
| ③ | **可扩展规则库** | 内置 9 条真实教训（见下），可随时往 `~/.dsh-home/whale-guard-rules.json` 加自己的坑，**改完存盘立即生效，不用重启**。 |
| ④ | **设置页** | **设置 → 防呆**：状态 / 处置方式（拦截⇄只提醒，点击即生效）/ 受保护进程链 / 规则清单（勾选即停用）/ 最近拦截日志 / 文件位置。 |

## 内置规则

| 规则 id | 触发场景 | 处置 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pkill-self-match` | `pkill -f <模式>` 而命令自身命令行含该模式 | **拦** + 给 safe_kill 写法 |
| `grep-xargs-kill-self-match` | `ps \| grep "<模式>" \| xargs kill` 会连自己一起杀 | **拦** |
| `sudo-heredoc-stdin` | `sudo -S` 与 heredoc 抢 stdin，密码喂不进去 | **拦** + 给「先落盘再提权」写法 |
| `sudo-needs-tty` | 非交互 shell 里 sudo 拿不到终端 | 提示（用 `-S` 或 `pkexec`） |
| `rm-rf-root` | `rm -rf /`、`rm -rf /etc` 等 | **拦** |
| `kill-pid1` | `kill 1` / `kill -9 1` | **拦** |
| `chmod-r777-root` | `chmod -R 777 /`（或系统目录） | **拦** |
| `local-bin-not-in-path` | 命令存在于 `~/.local/bin` 但不在当前 PATH 里 | 告警 + 给绝对路径写法 |
| `pip-no-mirror` | pip 命令没走国内镜像 | 提示（慢几十到几百倍） |

**防误伤设计**：预检会先剥掉注释、把引号内容换成位置标记。所以 `echo "文档里写的 rm -rf / 是反面教材"`、`grep "kill 1" /var/log/syslog`、`rm -rf ./build` 都**正常放行**——只有真会伤到自己的才拦。

## 设置页

**设置 → 防呆**：

![设置页](assets/settings-page.png)


## 自研插件图标

三个自研插件的设置页与设置导航图标是一套手绘矢量（24×24、描边 1.7、`stroke=currentColor`
跟随主题明暗），设计稿来自千问 `qwen-image-3.0`，再由我描成精确路径：

| 插件 | 图标 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| dsh-memory-lite | 摊开的书 + 便签卡 | 记忆库 |
| **dsh-whale-guard** | 盾牌 + 鲸鱼尾巴 | 守卫（盾）+ 本尊（鲸鱼） |
| dsh-multi-tts | 喇叭 + 声波 + 气泡 | 朗读出声 |

**为什么要动 DOM**：DSH 的 `navIcon(id)`（`dsh-client-ui-settings-general/lib/client.js`）是一张
**写死的表**，未登记的 section 一律回退系统齿轮，而 `settings.section` 的注册选项只有
`id/order/label`，没有图标位。所以每个插件的 `client.js` 在 `apply()` 里做一件事：
在 MutationObserver 里找到「自己那一行」的 `svg.navIcon` 并替换掉，命中范围仅此一个节点，
幂等、不动他人 DOM。React 重渲染会把它换回来，所以观察器持续纠偏（未命中时极廉价）。

**升级注意**：若 DSH 将来给 `settings.section` 加了图标字段，应改回声明式写法、删掉这段 DOM 逻辑。

## 用法

装好之后，直接在对话里用工具：

```
safe_kill({ pattern: "FurMark_GUI" })            # 默认 SIGTERM
safe_kill({ pattern: "comfy", signal: "SIGKILL" })
guard_status()                                   # 看保护链 / 规则数 / 最近命中
```

命令行等价物（顺手保留）：

```bash
/usr/local/bin/safepkill "FurMark_GUI"
```

## 配置（`cordis.patch.yml`）

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: whale-guard
      name: 'dsh-whale-guard'
      config:
        enabled: true              # 总开关
        mode: block                # block=真拦；warn=只告警放行
        precheckTools: [bash]      # 参与预检的工具
        rulesFile: ~/dsh-home/whale-guard-rules.json
        stateDir: ~/dsh-home/whale-guard   # 审计日志 audit.jsonl
        auditLog: true
        rules:
          disable: [pip-no-mirror]  # 关掉某条内置规则
          custom:                   # 或直接在配置里写规则
            - id: no-prod-restart
              title: 别直接重启生产实例
              severity: warn
              pattern: 'systemctl\\s+--user\\s+restart\\s+dsh-web'
              message: 生产实例重启前先确认回档点。
              fix: 先起隔离实例验证。
```

## 加自己的规则

编辑 `~/.dsh-home/whale-guard-rules.json`（插件首次运行会自动生成带示例的模板）：

```json
{
  "custom": [
    {
      "id": "任意唯一名",
      "title": "一句话说清这个坑",
      "severity": "block",
      "pattern": "正则表达式（对整条命令匹配，也可以给数组）",
      "message": "为什么错",
      "fix": "正确写法"
    }
  ]
}
```

- `severity`：`block`（拒绝执行）/ `warn`（告警放行）/ `hint`（轻声提示）
- 规则的 `pattern` 是对**整条原始命令**做正则匹配（大小写敏感，需要忽略大小写就加 `"flags": "i"`）
- 也可以写 `"builtin": "pkill-self-match"` 表示「复用某条内置规则的判定逻辑」

## 为什么 `safe_kill` 不会自杀

`pkill -f` 之所以自杀，是因为它匹配的是**完整命令行**，而执行这条 pkill 的 shell 命令行里就含该模式，于是「自己匹配自己」。

`safe_kill` 的链路：

1. 用 `pgrep -f` 拿候选 PID（只读，不杀）
2. 读 `/proc/<pid>/stat` 逐级上溯，算出**自身 + 全部祖先进程**的排除名单
3. 逐个 `process.kill()`，命中排除名单的直接跳过并在结果里说明原因

全程不拼 shell 字符串（无注入面），也不依赖 `~/.local/bin` 在 PATH 里（非交互 shell 的 PATH 坑绕开了）。

## 自检

```bash
node tools/selftest.mjs      # 78 项：规则命中/防误伤/heredoc 攻防/safe_kill 实战/设置页路由
```

## 上生产 / 更新

```bash
# 装进 profile（会把插件写进 profile 的 bundles，下次启动即加载）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:WYR-233/dsh-whale-guard
systemctl --user restart dsh-web        # 让当前实例加载新插件
```

- **安装方式是 `link:`**（符号链接到本目录），所以**本目录就是生产代码**：
  - 改 `lib/*.js` → 重启 DSH 后生效；
  - ⚠️ **别删/别移走本目录**，否则生产 profile 的链接会断（插件加载失败）。
- 规则文件 `~/.dsh-home/whale-guard-rules.json` 不随插件走，是**本机数据**，升级插件不影响它。
- 回档点（装之前的三件套备份）：`~/dsh-home/backups/pre-whale-guard-20261009-135612/`
- 审计日志：`~/.dsh-home/whale-guard/audit.jsonl`（每条命中的规则、命令、是否拦截）

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：万事通强尼 —— /johnny 出摊，没收到钱就装傻；敲钱喂给 dsh-pet 大肥鱼，才会说真话 | Pay the fish, get the truth
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-johnny

> DeepSeek Harness 插件：**万事通强尼 —— 没收到钱就装傻，钱到位全说。**

给你喜欢的桌宠（dsh-pet 大肥鱼）配一个"付费问答"小剧场：`/johnny` 出摊后，你说什么他都打太极（「有可能知道，有可能不知道。」）；想要真话，得**敲钱**、再把钱**喂给肥鱼**——鱼啃一口，真答案落进对话。

致敬《白头神探》前身剧《Police Squad!》里的擦鞋线人 Johnny——那位"什么都知道、但钱到位才肯说"的万事通。

## 三步玩起来

1. **出摊**：对话里输入 `/johnny`（再敲一次收摊；屏幕角落会出现「强尼模式」徽标 + 红色 ×，**点 × 秒退**）
2. **敲钱**（三通道任选）：
   - 桌面：鼠标 **左左·右右**
   - 手机：**摇一摇**
   - 或输入框打「**发钱**」发送（被拦下，不发给模型、不花 token）
3. **喂鱼**：把钱拖到肥鱼身上 → 鱼播动画 + 气泡「TOKEN 的味道……不错……」→ **真答案出现在对话里**

模式里你发的每句话都会被"扣下"：问题记进会话，强尼只回那一句招牌搪塞（鱼会同步动一下、冒泡帮腔）。**装傻环节零模型调用、零 token。**

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'https://codeload.github.com/wobenshiwomu/dsh-johnny/tar.gz/v0.1.0'
```

或在图形界面：侧栏「插件」→ 添加插件 → 填上面这条 URL。装完重启 DSH 生效。
URL 末段的 `v0.1.0` 是版本标签；升级时换成本仓库的新版本标签重装即可。

**建议搭配 [dsh-pet](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet)（大肥鱼桌宠）**——"喂鱼"环节靠它的 `/dsh-pet-7340` 接口。没有鱼也能玩：出摊 / 装傻 / 敲钱 / 红叉都好使，只有最后喂鱼那步会提示"鱼没反应"。

## 配置项（全部可选）

在 profile 用户层 `cordis.patch.yml` 覆盖：

```yaml
- id: dsh-johnny
  config:
    bubbleText: 'TOKEN 的味道……不错……'   # 喂钱后鱼气泡文案
    bubbleMeme: ''                          # 可选气泡配图（dsh-pet 表情包名，如 吃饱饱摸肚子）
    eatAnim: '余额-钱袋满溢'                 # 喂钱时鱼播的动画
    askBubbleText: '有可能知道，有可能不知道。'  # 扣下时鱼气泡文案（留空=不冒泡）
    askAnim: '工作状态-思考冒泡'              # 扣下时鱼播的动画（留空=不动）
    # petId: main                           # 联动的宠物 id
    # petBase: /dsh-pet-7340                # dsh-pet 接口前缀
    # moneyWords: [发钱, 给钱, 付钱, 交钱, 小费]  # 输入框召钱词表
    # storageDir: ''                        # 状态存储目录（默认 $DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-johnny）
```

## 原理（一段话）

模式里客户端在捕获层拦下你的发送；「点单」经 HTTP 进宿主后，用 `session.append(…, { surfaceOp: 'append' })` 把问题与搪塞台词写进会话（**不惊动模型、零 token**）；喂钱触发 `resolveAgent → agent.followup`，把被扣的问题包进「鱼已收钱」消息——只有这一轮"真回答"过一次模型。鱼的反应（动画 + 气泡）由客户端同源调用 dsh-pet 接口完成。

> 小注：最初想让模型亲自"演"强尼，真机实测模型会把"装傻要钱"判为操纵性/注入而拒绝出演；改成"拦截式台词池"后反而更稳、更省、更好笑——他每次都说同一句，就是笑点。

## 测试

- `node test/sim.mjs`：**66 项断言**（模式开关与持久化 / 点单扣话 / 解锁载荷 / HTTP 路由 / 配置透传）
- 真机 E2E：扣下时零模型调用（assistant 计数不变）→ 喂钱 → 模型答出暗号（TOKEN-99），全链路贯通

## 已知问题

- Android/Termux 上使用 dsh-pet 需要先让它能正常加载：其静态 import 的 `@electron-internal/extract-zip` 没有安卓预编译，会在插件加载期抛错；可用 `pnpm patch` 换成懒桩绕过（该模块只在桌面模式用到）。修复建议（改成使用时动态 import）已同步给 dsh-pet 仓库。
- dsh-pet 的"桌面模式"（Electron 透明窗）在安卓不可用，属上游限制；Web 模式不受影响。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Per-session todo lists for DeepSeek Harness: user-defined columns, completion, batch actions, undo and CSV export, plus agent access through a tool.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-todos

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：**每个会话独立的待办清单**，列由用户自定义，默认只有「序号｜事项」。

界面与 AI 共用同一份数据：你在面板上勾选，模型能读到；模型写进去的事项，面板也会显示。

## 特性

- **会话隔离**：每个会话有自己的事项与列配置，互不影响。
- **自定义列**：文本 / 数字 / 日期三种类型，可新增、重命名、左右移动、删除；事项列可改名但不可删除。
- **事项操作**：新增、编辑、删除（带确认）、勾选完成、再次勾选恢复未完成、上移 / 下移。
- **搜索与筛选**：搜索所有列，筛选全部 / 未完成 / 已完成。
- **批量操作**：批量完成、恢复、删除（作用于当前筛选结果）。
- **撤销**：最近 20 次操作可回退，包含删除列及其数据；没有重做。
- **导出 CSV**：导出全量清单（不是当前筛选），带完成标记，兼容中文 Excel，并对公式注入做了转义。
- **按需展示**：不创建就不显示、不占空间；展开后的宽度、内边距、折叠摘要对齐原生任务框。
- **AI 可用**：模型通过 `session_todos` 工具读写同一份清单，与界面共用同一个宿主方法。

## 安装

安装一个 DSH 插件是**两步**，缺一不可：

1. **装依赖** —— 让包在 profile 里可解析；
2. **启用 bundle** —— 把包名写进 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`。

`dsh plugin --profile <name> <args...>` 只是 **pnpm 的转发**（在 profile 目录里执行），所以它只完成第 1 步：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Tpihis/dsh-session-todos.git
cd dsh-session-todos
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD"        # ① 装依赖
```

第 2 步没有对应的 CLI 命令，用插件管理器完成：

- GUI：侧边栏「插件」面板里把 `dsh-session-todos` 打开；
- 或让 agent 调 `plugin_manager`：`set_bundle`，`target = dsh-session-todos`，`enabled = true`；
- 或一步到位：`plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`，`target` 指向本目录（安装 + 启用）。

**只做第 1 步插件不会加载。** 这不是猜测：`dsh` 只提供 `dsh plugin`（pnpm 转发）和 `--patch` 两个入口，没有 `dsh bundle` 之类的命令；而且本机 profile 里就有一个实例——`@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skill-explorer` 在 `dependencies` 里但不在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里，因此始终 `enabled: false`。

验证是否启用成功：

```sh
node -e 'console.log(require(process.env.HOME+"/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json").dsh.profile.bundles)'
```

名字出现在这个列表里，并且插件面板显示已启用，才算装好。

安装完成后：

- 宿主半即时生效；
- **客户端半需要刷新一次页面（F5）**才会出现新代码；
- 没有 `pnpm run dev:web` 时，客户端插件不会自动热更新。

## 使用

打开任意会话，输入框上方会出现一行「会话待办」摘要（**未创建清单时不显示**）。点开即可编辑。

也可以直接对模型说：

> 把这些需求加入当前会话待办，并增加分类、优先级和截止日期列。

模型侧的 `todo_write` 是它自己的执行计划，与本清单无关。

## 数据与边界

- 数据存在宿主存储域 `session_custom_todos`（本机位于 `~/.dsh/storages/session_custom_todos/`），**不在插件目录内**，卸载插件不会删除数据。
- 每个会话最多 2000 条事项、20 个数据列；列名最多 80 字符，单元格最多 10000 字符。
- 并发写使用 revision 检查：拿旧版本号提交会被拒绝，提示刷新后重试。
- 会话分支（fork）默认是空白清单，不继承父会话。
- 会话删除后，其域记录不会自动清理。

## 已知限制

- **写操作会在对话里留下一条命令卡片**。界面的写操作通过斜杠命令 `/session-todos` 落到宿主，而 DSH 一定会把命令生命周期（`command/run` + `command/done`）渲染成卡片，无法避免。为让它可读，每次写操作返回一句中文摘要（如「已完成 1 条（2/3 已完成）」），卡片摘要行显示该文本，而不是默认的「已完成」。摘要生成在 `src/model.js` 的 `summarize()`。
- 想做到**完全不产生这类卡片**，需要改用插件自建的 typert RPC（宿主 `ctx.typert.register` + 客户端 `ctx.remote.$mount`）。曾实现过一版，但桥接调用挂起会让面板写入锁卡死，未收敛，故采用当前折中方案。
- 未做第二台机器、其他 DSH 版本、其他操作系统的验证。

## 开发

```
src/host.js        宿主半（apply / inject，命令、工具、会话投影、存储域）
src/model.js       纯业务逻辑（校验、变更、撤销、视图、摘要）+ 单元测试
src/model.test.js  测试：node --test src/model.test.js
client.js          浏览器半（React，通过 __ModuleLoader__ 注册）
cordis.patch.yml   bundle 补丁，插入一行 session-todos
```

### 改完代码为什么不生效

运行中的 DSH 进程按 URL 缓存已导入的模块，而 profile 安装的 bundle **不会**因为自身文件变化而热重载。原地改文件，跑的还是旧模块。

```sh
npm run refresh     # 给入口的相对导入写入内容哈希 ./model.js?v=<hash>
```

然后重新启用 bundle（或重启 DSH）。哈希必须是**字面量**——Loader 要静态读取入口的 `export const inject`，所以不能用 `Date.now()` / `Math.random()` 在运行时拼。

注意：`refresh` 只能让入口**的依赖**换 URL；如果入口文件本身（`src/host.js`）的缓存需要失效，仍然要重启 DSH 或更换入口文件名。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness ⇄ JetBrains integration: DSH chat inside your IDE, and your IDE workspace — project, attached modules, active file and caret — in front of the model.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH ⇄ JetBrains

Small packages that connect a local [DeepSeek Harness](../../) (DSH) to a JetBrains IDE, so the IDE and
the agent share one workspace instead of two islands.

Each one works on its own: the IDE plugin and the DSH bundle are the two halves of the same workflow, and
the session-link plugin only lets a page be asked for a session by address. The DSH bundle carries both a
Host half and a web-client half, so installing it covers the tool, the context line, and the clicks.

| Package | Platform | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [`jetbrains-companion/`](jetbrains-companion) | IntelliJ Platform plugin (Java, no Gradle) | **DSH Chat** tool window embedding DSH's own web client, one DSH session per IDE window, live workspace publication, a loopback bridge so DSH can put a file in front of you, and a `DSH Changes` tool window that shows a published turn as a native side-by-side IntelliJ diff. |
| [`jetbrains-workspace/`](jetbrains-workspace) | DSH profile bundle (host half + web-client half, plain JavaScript) | Reads the IDE's workspace — including a module's multiple content roots from its `.iml` — into DSH as a tool, a runtime context line, and a registered workspace. Works with the companion running or from the IDE's own state files after it closed. Sends opened and clicked files to the IDE: the Host half replaces DSH's default desktop opener, and the client half redirects the Sidebar file viewer. |
| [`jetbrains-session-link/`](jetbrains-session-link) | DSH client plugin (plain JavaScript) | Lets `#dsh-session=<id>` — or a hash change on an open page — select that session without a reload. Optional: the chat panel falls back to the client's stored selection when it is absent. |

> **Unofficial.** Neither package is made by, endorsed by, or affiliated with JetBrains or DeepSeek.
> IntelliJ, IDEA and JetBrains are trademarks of JetBrains s.r.o.

## What you get

- **Chat inside the IDE.** The `DSH Chat` tool window renders DSH's web client, authenticated with the
  same browser-session cookie DSH gives a browser, and opens the session for the window you are in.
- **One workspace, seen from both sides.** The window's root project and every attached module/VCS
  directory reach the model as a runtime context line and as a `jetbrains_workspace` tool result, with
  each directory labelled by the source that reported it.
- **Round trip.** DSH can read the active file, caret and selection, and open a file in the IDE at a
  line — with the companion's bridge, or with the IDE state files when the IDE is closed.

- **Review a turn as a diff.** `DSH Changes` lists every turn `dsh-jetbrains-workspace` publishes and
  opens any changed file as a native side-by-side IntelliJ diff. A turn's diff also opens by itself, with a
  **Keep** / **Revert** notification, the chat panel's toolbar has a **Changes** toggle, and reverting works
  per file or per hunk — refusing rather than half-reverting a file that changed since the turn.
- **Nothing is lost while the IDE is closed.** The review document outlives the IDE: on the next start the
  companion mentions the turns it missed, with one click to the panel.

## Why one DSH, not one per project

Because the value is in seeing everything at once. One Host process holds every session, so a reader can keep
an agent running in one project under watch while working on something else in another session that has
nothing to do with the IDE. It is also why this bundle publishes one review document for the whole Host
rather than one per workspace: the changes panel lists the turns of every session that changed files, so an
agent left running in another project still reports where the reader already is.

The IDE side leans the same way. One companion serves the whole IDE: the chat panel keeps one session per
project, the window junction can be told to register the shared parent so a multi-module checkout is one
workspace (`junctionRoot: common-parent`), and `jetbrains_workspace` answers for every attached directory.

What that costs, measured rather than assumed: the companion descriptor is *one file per user*, and the
companion starts **one bridge per IDE run**. Opening a second IDE window produced no second `bridge on` line,
and the one descriptor already named both windows' projects. So a Host reaches every window through one
bridge, DSH's workspace tool sees all of them, and the companion decides which window shows a diff or opens a
file by matching the path against each project's base path. The Host also accepts a *set* of descriptors (the
single one plus any `jetbrains-companion/*.json` beside it) and chooses by workspace, so a future build that
publishes one descriptor per window needs no Host change.

## What each half gives you

Each half is useful alone, and they do not depend on each other to install. What you get changes:

| Capability | IDE plugin only | DSH bundle only | Both |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DSH Chat` tool window in the IDE (embedded DSH client, cookie auth) | yes | — | yes |
| One DSH session per IDE window, grouped in the DSH sidebar | yes — the panel registers the workspace and creates or attaches the session itself | — | yes |
| The model knows which IDE window is open (runtime context line) | — | yes, from the IDE's state files, or live when the companion runs | yes |
| `jetbrains_workspace` tool: root project, module content roots, active file, caret, selection | — | yes | yes |

| A turn's diff opens by itself, with Keep / Revert | yes — `POST /changed` on the companion bridge | yes — posts the notice (`autoOpenDiffs`) | yes |

The two halves talk through DSH's own HTTP API and the companion's descriptor
(`<DSH home>/jetbrains-companion.json`, carrying a `version` and a `source` marker), so either half can
be updated on its own: a bundle that finds no live descriptor falls back to the IDE's state files, and a
